newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal sells marks at 100.13 esc - dealers.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal sells marks at 100.13 esc - dealers.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal intervened in the foreign exchange market, selling marks around 100.13 escudos per mark to avoid a sharp drop in the Portuguese currency, dealers said.
"The Bank of Portugal was selling marks at 100.13, 100.14 and 100.15 escudos per mark in order to avoid a drop in the escudo," one dealer said.
Bank of Portugal officials were not immediately available for comment.
